list.heading: Sync rules
list.intro: Each rule shows the events of one calendar in another, as busy time or with their details. The source calendar is never changed.
list.draftSavedNotice: Draft saved. Preview it to see exactly what will be written before anything changes.

empty.title: No rules yet
empty.connectFirst: Connect a calendar account in Settings, then create your first rule here.
empty.createFirst: Create a rule, preview its effects, then start syncing.

list.reprojectionRequired: Preview required: the policy changed, so existing projections are rewritten on the first run after you start syncing again.
list.stoppedDisconnected: Synchronization stopped: {accounts} must be reauthorized before this rule can run.
list.stoppedGeneric: Synchronization stopped to protect your calendars. Nothing was lost; preview the rule to restart it.

tentativeHint.sync: Shown the same as events you accepted.
tentativeHint.skip: Events you answered Maybe stay out of the destination.

unansweredHint.treatedAsMaybe: Treated as Maybe, so they stay out of the destination too. Declined events are never synced.

unansweredFact.skipLikeMaybe: Not synced, like events you answered Maybe

consequence.maybeDeleted: Events you answered Maybe will be deleted from {destination} on the next run.
consequence.maybeAdded: Events you answered Maybe will be added to {destination} on the next run.
consequence.maybeMarked: Events you answered Maybe will be marked as tentative in {destination} on the next run.
consequence.maybeUnmarked: Events you answered Maybe will lose their tentative mark in {destination} on the next run.
consequence.unansweredDeleted: Invitations you haven't answered will be deleted from {destination} on the next run.
consequence.unansweredAdded: Invitations you haven't answered will be added to {destination} as Maybe events on the next run.

builder.heading: Choose the calendars
builder.intro: Saving creates a draft. Nothing is written until you preview the rule and start syncing.
builder.sameEndpointError: Choose a destination different from the source calendar.

allDay.label: Sync all-day events
allDay.hint: Turn this off to synchronize timed events only.

builder.noCalendars: This account has no calendars to choose.
builder.noWritableCalendars: This account has no writable calendars to choose.
